2b92911dc1cad928ecfc8a42d00850cf737d8722.summary: Rewterz threat alert (published 2023-12-30) reports that Microsoft again disabled the ms-appinstaller protocol handler after threat actors abused it for initial access. Signed malicious MSIX app packages, spread through Microsoft Teams or malvertising, were used by at least four financially motivated groups since November 2023 to deliver tools such as BATLOADER, FakeBat, and DarkGate, feeding ransomware operations. Named groups include Storm-0569, Storm-1113, Storm-1674, and Sangria Tempest (aka FIN7 and Carbon Spider). A separate October 2023 campaign used fake MSIX packages to deliver…

2b48767adb8cf497d8ea235e224cde9d4fa2af04.summary: Carbanak is an APT-style campaign against financial institutions, discovered in 2014 by Kaspersky Lab. Phishing emails delivered malware to Windows systems, which the criminals used to steal money from banks through ATM cash dispensing, altered account balances and SWIFT transfers via money mules. The report says the group stole over 900 million dollars. Targets were said to be mainly in Russia, then the United States, Germany, China and Ukraine. FireEye tracked the group as FIN7, and Europol claimed an arrest in Spain in 2018. Several details, including the scale of losses and the extent of…
